# devin-doctor

> Diagnostics CLI for a Devin Desktop installation — one command that checks local stores, schema versions, config files and disk usage, then prints a health report with concrete fix suggestions. `brew doctor` for Devin.

Devin keeps local state — a versioned `sessions.db`, one `acp-messages/*.db` per GUI session, a `state.vscdb` KV store, `credentials.toml`, JSONC config — and nothing warns you when it breaks or bloats. devin-doctor runs five read-only checks (stores, schema, health-of-data, config, disk), each printing `PASS`/`WARN`/`FAIL`, a one-line finding and a `fix:` suggestion. Built on devin-internals-spec, so it understands the `refinery_schema_history` ledger, per-session stores and `.devin/` hooks/MCP format.

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/Icaro0310/devin-explore/blob/main/README.md): full documentation
- [devin-internals-spec](https://github.com/Icaro0310/devin-internals-spec): the store schema/parsers this builds on

## Key commands
- `devin-doctor check`: diagnose the default Devin data dir
- `devin-doctor check --data-dir <path> --config-dir <path>`: diagnose stores in non-default locations
- `devin-doctor check --json`: machine-readable output
- `devin-doctor check --integrations` / `--live`: opt-in checks — half-configured CI via `git`+`gh`, Slack/Ollama connectivity probes
- `devin-doctor report --md`: markdown report, for pasting into issues
- `uv tool install devin-doctor  # or: pipx install devin-doctor`: install the CLI
- `python -m pytest`: run the test suite (synthetic fixtures only)

## When to use / when not
- Use when: missing history, auth errors or disk pressure hint at broken Devin local state; you want a first-pass health check before debugging; you need a paste-able report for an issue.
- Not when: you want it to fix things (read-only; `--fix` is planned); the Devin schema is newer than v17 (reports "unknown version" FAIL by design); Devin is running and stores are locked (`SQLITE_BUSY` — close Devin and re-run).
